Simple.name: Battlestaff
Simple.description: A sturdy wooden staff, which can be used in somantic components

Simple.name: Bayonet
Simple.description: Bayonets can fastened to rifles for a good but inaccurate reserve melee weapon

Simple.name: Buckler
Simple.description: Bucklers are light shields that allows the wearer to also use the hand for interacting with objects, though they can't their shield hand to perform somatic components or wield weapons

Simple.name: Club
Simple.description: A simple wooden club, easy to make and use

Simple.name: Dagger
Simple.traits: Precision, Finesse, Versatile (Slashing), Agile, Thrown (3), Light
Simple.description: A simple fallback weapon that can also be thrown in a pitch

Simple.name: Mace
Simple.description: A simple club with a heavy head, effective against armored foes

Simple.name: Runegun Pistol
Simple.description: Fitting the runes of runegun on a one-handed object requires great skill, but they are an effective weapon.

Simple.name: Runegun Rifle
Simple.description: Runegun rifles use mana to accelerate bullets to high speeds.

Simple.name: Shield
Simple.description: Shields can protect the user from spells and attacks

Simple.name: Shortbow
Simple.description: A light and easy to handle bow, favored by rangers and scouts

Simple.name: Sling
Simple.description: Slings are simple weapons, but underestimating them have lead to many a leaders downfall

Simple.name: Spear
Simple.description: A long pole weapon that can be thrown or used to keep enemies at bay

Simple.name: Throwing Axe
Simple.description: A small axe designed for throwing, but can also be used in melee combat

Martial.name: Arbalest
Martial.description: A large crossbow that takes longer to reload, but delivers devastating power

Martial.name: Channeling Staff
Martial.description: A special staff used by mages to focus and aim their spells

Martial.name: Crossbow
Martial.description: A ranged weapon that fires bolts with great force

Martial.name: Glaive
Martial.description: A pole weapon with a single edged blade, favored by infantry for its versatility

Martial.name: Greataxe
Martial.description: A large two handed axe, capable of cleaving through armor and bone alike

Martial.name: Greatsword
Martial.description: A large two handed sword that can cleave through multiple enemies in one swing

Martial.name: Halberd
Martial.description: A pole weapon with an axe blade and a spike, capable of keeping foes at reach

Martial.name: Longbow
Martial.description: A powerful bow, capable of hitting targets at long range

Martial.name: Longstaff
Martial.description: Longstaffs are longer battlestaves to channel magic in battle

Martial.name: Longsword
Martial.description: The standard sword of choice for many soldiers and adventurers

Martial.name: Maul
Martial.description: A large two handed hammer, capable of crushing armor and bone alike

Martial.name: Parrying Dagger
Martial.traits: Precision, Finesse, Versatile (Slashing), Agile, Parry, Light
Martial.description: Parrying daggers are specialized weapons for duelists

Martial.name: Pike
Martial.description: Pikes have great reach, but are hard to use in close combat

Martial.name: Rapier
Martial.description: A duelists weapon, for outmaneuvering their foes on the battlefield

Martial.name: Runegun Cannon
Martial.traits: Deadly (d10), Heavy, Loud, Ranged, Reload (2), Slowing 1
Martial.description: Runegun Cannons are weapons made for war, but their size and weight make them generally unfit for adventurers

Martial.name: Runegun Sharpshot
Martial.traits: Deadly (d10), Precision, Loud, Ranged, Reload (1), Volley (4)
Martial.description: Sharpshots are specialized runeguns that are cumbersome to use, but extremely accurate a long range

Martial.name: Shortsword
Martial.description: A light and easy to handle sword, favored by rogues and scouts

Martial.name: Tower Shield
Martial.description: Tower Shields are heavy and cumbersome, but very effective protection

Martial.name: Warhammer
Martial.description: A solid hammer, effective against armored foes

Advanced.name: Atlatl
Advanced.description: Atlats are specialized spearthrowers used by Brannur huntmaster. They can propel deadly spears impressive distances

Advanced.name: Bola
Advanced.description: Bolas are composed of weights tied to a metal rope. They can trip foes at range

Advanced.name: Flail
Advanced.description: Flails are complex weapons, but can in the right hand be wielded with devastating force

Advanced.name: Shuriken
Advanced.description: Shurikens are rare weapons which see use by Vesper assassins

Advanced.name: War Pick
Advanced.description: War picks are unorthodox weapons, but when they hit, they hit hard.

Advanced.name: Whip
Advanced.description: Whips may seem simple, but are complicated weapons to wield effectively.

Unarmed.name: Claw
Unarmed.description: Naga and Yirte posses sharp claws that can serve as emergency weapons

Unarmed.name: Dragon's Claws
Unarmed.description: Dragonkin's sharp claws can cut through many things, but their not as dexterous as a nagas or yirtes

Unarmed.name: Unarmed Strike
Unarmed.description: Punching people has always been a way to fight

Artificers.name: Impact Gauntlet
Artificers.description: Impact Gauntlets lets their wielders punch with extraordinarie force

Artificers.name: Powered Hammer
Artificers.description: Powered hammers bring intense power from careful runework

Artificers.name: Whip Sword
Artificers.description: Whip swords are advanced weapons which can extend to have surprising reach.

Special.name: Claw
Special.description: Quadruped golems can attack foes with their sharp claws

Special.name: Slam
Special.description: Brawler type golems use their fists as simple, but effective weapons

Special.name: Stomp
Special.description: The legs of quadruped golems is another deadly weapon
